description: ADTS at 22050 Hz of ten channel pairs, the second, fifth and eighth followed by an SBR payload (the first with an SBR header): three blocks of ten, which is fewer than half of them, so the stream stays AAC LC at 22050 Hz.
findings: only 3 of 10 raw data blocks hold SBR data after a channel element

skip.faad: faad -i prints twice the rate of any ADTS stream at 24 kHz or less, whatever its frames hold.
skip.decode: ffmpeg prints "No quantized data read for sbr_dequant" for the SBR payloads in the middle of the stream.
